newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Brierley knocks BIL selldown of Thistle.
newsitem.headline: Brierley knocks BIL selldown of Thistle.

text.p: Brierley Investments Ltd founder and director Sir Ron Brierley on Thursday criticised the company's recent selldown of its holding in British hotel group Thistle Hotels.

The hotel company has been regarded by many investors as a millstone around BIL's neck, comprising around half of the company's consolidated assets until the recent selldown to 46 percent from 70 percent as part of Thistle's London listing.
Analysts believe BIL has received inadequate returns from Thistle since BIL took it over in 1990.
Asked if GPG Ltd, the investment company Brierley is most involved with these days, would invest in Thistle, Brierley said GPG was too small to influence things.
